content_of_post_to_comment: Why do I do this? I can't seem to finish my novel. I just have a paragraph, not even a full book done. Just one paragraph on the first page. I know what my story is about and where it's going. How do other writers get past this?
comment: Maybe the hardest part isn't writing the novel but accepting that the first draft has to be a version you don't yet believe in. Knowing the destination can sometimes make the blank page heavier, because every sentence feels like it must match the finished vision.
